```{r}
region <- "PFC"
celltype <- "Astro"
```


```{r}
atac_de_path <- ## REVISION: the published code read results_ATAC/INS_*.RDS for every
##   region (the published files were all named INS_*). 04-ATAC_DE writes
##   <REGION>_HIV-CTR_res_edgeR_filtered_withFreq.RDS in data_ATAC/.
file.path(OUT_ROOT, "04-ATAC_DE", region, "data_ATAC",
          paste0(region, "_HIV-CTR_res_edgeR_filtered_withFreq.RDS"))
atac_de <- readRDS(atac_de_path)
atac_de_micro <- atac_de$table$`HIV-CTR`[[celltype]]
atac_de_micro_all <- atac_de_micro[which(abs(atac_de_micro$logFC) >= 0.5 & atac_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]
atac_de_micro_up <- atac_de_micro[which(atac_de_micro$logFC >= 0.5 & atac_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]
atac_de_micro_down <- atac_de_micro[which(atac_de_micro$logFC <= -0.5 & atac_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]


rna_de_path <- paste0(file.path(OUT_ROOT, "03-DE_analysis/"),region,"/results/",region,"_HIV-CTR_res_edgeR_filtered.RDS")
rna_de <-  readRDS(rna_de_path)
rna_de_micro <- rna_de$table$`HIV-CTR`[[celltype]]
rna_de_micro_up <- rna_de_micro[which(rna_de_micro$logFC >= 0.5 & rna_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]
rna_de_micro_down <- rna_de_micro[which(rna_de_micro$logFC <= -0.5 & rna_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]
rna_de_micro_all <- rna_de_micro[which(abs(rna_de_micro$logFC) >= 0.5 & rna_de_micro$p_adj.glb <= 0.05),]


```


```{r}
circuits_file <- paste0(paste0(MAGICAL_OUTPUT_DIR, "/"),region,"_",celltype,"MAGICAL_selected_regulatory_circuits.txt")
circuits <- read_table(circuits_file)

expanded_circuits <- circuits %>%
  mutate(TFs = str_split(TFs, ",\\s*")) %>%  # Split TFs at commas, assuming optional spaces
  unnest(TFs)  # Expand the list column into separate rows

expanded_circuits <- expanded_circuits %>%
  dplyr::filter(TFs != "" & !is.na(TFs))


expanded_circuits$peakname <- paste0(expanded_circuits$Peak_chr,"-",expanded_circuits$Peak_start,"-",expanded_circuits$Peak_end)

expanded_circuits <- expanded_circuits[, c("TFs", "peakname", "Gene_symbol")]

expanded_circuits <- expanded_circuits[order(expanded_circuits$TFs), ]


folder <- paste0(paste0(MAGICAL_ANALYZED, "/"),region,"_new_",celltype,"/")
write.csv(expanded_circuits, paste0(folder,"expanded_circuits.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
print(paste0("unique TFs (before fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits$TFs))))
print(paste0("unique Peaks (before fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits$peakname))))
print(paste0("unique Genes (before fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits$Gene_symbol))))
```


Filter the circuit for plot
```{R}
n_genes <- 21
n_TF <- 8

rna_de_micro_all_filtered <- rna_de_micro_all[which(rna_de_micro_all$gene %in% expanded_circuits$Gene_symbol),]
rna_de_micro_all_filtered <- rna_de_micro_all_filtered[order(abs(rna_de_micro_all_filtered$logFC),decreasing = TRUE), ]
top_genes <- rna_de_micro_all_filtered[1:n_genes,]$gene

expanded_circuits_filtered <- expanded_circuits[which(expanded_circuits$Gene_symbol %in% top_genes),]
print(paste0("unique TFs (after gene fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$TFs))))
print(paste0("unique Peaks (after gene fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$peakname))))
print(paste0("unique Genes (after gene fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$Gene_symbol))))

TF_table <- table(expanded_circuits_filtered$TFs)
TF_table <- as.data.frame(TF_table)
TF_table <- TF_table[order(TF_table$Freq,decreasing = TRUE),]
chosen_TF <- TF_table$Var1[1:n_TF]
expanded_circuits_filtered <- expanded_circuits_filtered[which(expanded_circuits_filtered$TFs %in% chosen_TF), ]
print(paste0("unique TFs (after TF fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$TFs))))
print(paste0("unique Peaks (after TF fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$peakname))))
print(paste0("unique Genes (after TF fitering): ",length(unique(expanded_circuits_filtered$Gene_symbol))))

write.csv(expanded_circuits_filtered, paste0(folder,"expanded_circuits_filtered.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Create network file
```{r}
create_cytoscape_network <- function(data, output_file) {
    
    # Create TF-peak edges
    tf_peak <- data %>%
        dplyr::select(Source=TFs, Target=peakname) %>%
        mutate(Interaction="regulates")
    
    # Create peak-gene edges
    peak_gene <- data %>%
        dplyr::select(Source=peakname, Target=Gene_symbol) %>%
        mutate(Interaction="associated_with")
    
    # Combine edges
    network <- rbind(tf_peak, peak_gene)
    
    # Write output
    write.table(network, output_file, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
    
    return(network)
}

create_cytoscape_network_no_overlap <- function(data, output_file) {
    
    # Create TF-peak edges
    tf_peak <- data %>%
        dplyr::select(Source=TFs, Target=peakname) %>%
        mutate(Interaction="regulates")
    
    # Create peak-gene edges
    peak_gene <- data %>%
        dplyr::select(Source=peakname, Target=Gene_symbol) %>%
        mutate(Interaction="associated_with")
    
    # Combine edges
    network <- rbind(tf_peak, peak_gene)
    
    network <- unique(network)
    
    # Write output
    write.table(network, output_file, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
    
    return(network)
}

create_cytoscape_network(expanded_circuits_filtered,paste0(folder,"cyto_df.csv"))
create_cytoscape_network_no_overlap(expanded_circuits_filtered,paste0(folder,"cyto_df_no_overlap.csv"))
```
 Add node type:
```{r}
peaks_up <- expanded_circuits_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(peakname %in% atac_de_micro_up$gene)%>%
  dplyr::select(peakname) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(node = peakname) %>%
  mutate(type = "peak_up")

peaks_down <- expanded_circuits_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(peakname %in% atac_de_micro_down$gene)%>%
  dplyr::select(peakname) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(node = peakname) %>%
  mutate(type = "peak_down")


TFs <- expanded_circuits_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(TFs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(node = TFs) %>%
  mutate(type = "TFs")

genes_up <- expanded_circuits_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_symbol %in% rna_de_micro_up$gene)%>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(node = Gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(type = "de_up")

genes_down <- expanded_circuits_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_symbol %in% rna_de_micro_down$gene)%>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(node = Gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(type = "de_down")

# Combine all nodes
node_types <- bind_rows(TFs, peaks_up,peaks_down,genes_up,genes_down)
write.table(node_types, paste0(folder,"node_types.csv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)


```
